description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a Louisiana-style fast-food chain known for its fried chicken, biscuits, and Cajun-influenced sides. This location on 152 Street offers takeout service and sits along a busy commercial corridor in the Surrey area. For touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley gateway, it provides a quick, filling stop with familiar menu options.
